NOTE: BBC News. BBC homepage (Tue 21 Jul) headline: "Burnham pledges to show how policies will be paid for after ex-minister hits out at 'unfunded' tax cut" + Chris Mason analysis "Starmer ally takes swipe at Burnham's first big policy." Confirms the Darren Jones (sacked chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster) attack on the VAT cut as unfunded, and Burnham's pledge that ministers must show how policies are paid for. BBC live/cabinet page also: Trump call readout (North Sea oil, military alliance, de-mining Strait of Hormuz; Trump on Truth Social "very good conversation", "went very well", meet "not too distant future"); Burnham spoke to Zelensky (invited to UK) and Macron; No 10 North being set up at Heron House, Manchester (Specialist Operations police seen guarding site); DSIT merged into Department for Business and Trade; Healey first words as Chancellor: work "in lockstep" with PM "to meet the fiscal rules with a buffer against uncertainty".
